I don't have today's price move data for MPC, so I can't tell you what direction the stock moved or by how much. Without that information, I can't explain the day's move in the way you're asking.

That said, the news from today shows Marathon Petroleum released its quarterly earnings and announced a leadership change, both of which typically move a stock — the earnings figure itself and the market's reaction to guidance for coming quarters will matter more than the headline numbers. Refinery utilization is running at a solid 92.8%, and oil prices remain elevated (US crude at $103, global at $123), which supports refiner margins, but broader sentiment toward Big Oil earnings has been cautious according to reporting from earlier this week.
